review.method: Locally animated selected illustration and FFmpeg, preserving the original rendering style; no paid video model calls.
review.audio_review: Exact mechanics narration generated with installed Samantha voice, mixed with original synthesized stereo music and event-synchronized SFX. AAC stream, non-silence and peak levels verified. Audio was not independently listened to.
review.narration: Drag a matching item into an open slot. Three identical goods clear the shelf.
review.summary: One continuous row-four center-to-left carton drag; exactly three FRUIT cartons snap together and clear into the source SOLD OUT marker. Source middle slot is empty, with cups and travel cup remaining. No further match or reward.
review.layout: Seven-by-three shelf, headline and native shaded toy materials retained. Six encoded frames at0,2.7,4.5,6.8,8.6,11.5 seconds inspected.
review.game_feel: Pickup anticipation, curved drag, restrained destination highlight, crisp snap, synchronized three-item pop, contained particles and stamp settle, with matching input/contact/chime/stamp sounds.
limitations: The baked hand and ghost are separated locally. Hidden central shelf products and backing are reconstructed from matching source-image goods and source-verified types.
Some cloned product edges and shelf-floor patch seams remain visible at full size. The source SOLD OUT graphic is reused at its saved resolution.
This is a presentation mockup, not gameplay recorded from the original or a rebuilt Unity game.
